places.name: Domäne Dahlem
places.price: €4.50 entry, €2 reduced, under 12 free. Pay for pumpkins at the field tills, cash.
places.hours: Sat and Sun 10:00 to 18:00, harvesting stops at 17:00.
places.what: The one real cut-your-own field inside the city. You collect a sack at the field edge (€2 deposit) and pick Hokkaido, butternut and spaghetti squash off the Domäne's own acre.
places.trip: U3 to Dahlem-Dorf, then about 3 minutes on foot. Around 40 minutes from Alexanderplatz with one change.
weeks: Erntefest: the only pumpkin harvest weekend, Saturday 3 and Sunday 4 October.

places.name: Späth'sche Baumschulen
places.price: Free to walk around. Edible pumpkins are sold by weight in the farm shop.
places.hours: Plant yard Sat 9:00 to 16:00, Sun 10:00 to 14:00 (3 Oct 10:00 to 15:00). Farm shop Tue to Sun 11:00 to 18:00.
places.what: A show of around 100 varieties grown on site, next to the tree nursery. You pick your pumpkin from the display and pay by weight.
places.trip: S-Bahn to Baumschulenweg, then bus 170 to Baumschulenstr./Königsheideweg. About 30 minutes from Alexanderplatz.
weeks: Show open. Sunday plant yard closes at 14:00.
Show open. Saturday is a holiday: plant yard 10:00 to 15:00.
Show open, last full weekend before it winds down.
The show runs to "early November". Call before you go.

places.name: Spargel- und Erlebnishof Klaistow
places.price: €6 on weekends and holidays, €4 on weekdays, under 12 free.
places.what: The big one: this year's theme is Hollywood, with more than 100,000 pumpkins built into film characters, a corn maze until 31 October and a farm shop selling the varieties it grows.
places.trip: S-Bahn to Charlottenburg, RE7 to Borkheide or RE1 to Werder (Havel), then bus 541 or 641 to Klaistow, Dorf. About 80 minutes with two changes. Outside the ABC zone.
weeks: Pumpkin carving 12:00 to 17:00 both days. Sunday 27 Sep at 14:00: the largest-pumpkin weigh-off.
Show open. Corn maze closes 31 October.
Sunday 1 Nov at 14:00: the pumpkins are cut up and sold off.
Show open until 15 November. Sunday 8 Nov: autumn flea market.

places.name: Karls Erlebnis-Dorf Elstal
places.price: Free entry to the village. Rides and the shop cost extra.
places.hours: Daily 8:00 to 19:00. Pumpkin season runs until 1 November.
places.what: Pumpkin pyramids, straw bales and giant pumpkin figures across a free farm-themed village. More decoration and photo spots than farm; pumpkins are sold in the shop.
places.trip: RE4 from Hauptbahnhof or RB21 from Charlottenburg to Elstal, then bus 668 to Elstal, Zum Erlebnis-Dorf. About 55 to 60 minutes. Inside ABC.
weeks: Pumpkin season on. Check the journey planner: the timetable showed diversions for this weekend.
Last weekend: pumpkin season ends 1 November.

places.name: Spargelhof Kremmen
places.price: No entry fee for the pumpkin market.
places.hours: Pumpkin market Friday to Sunday through the season. Festival 17 and 18 October, 10:00 to 18:00.
places.what: A farm pumpkin market with around 30 varieties and advice on what to cook with which. On festival weekend the historic barn quarter opposite fills with carving, market stalls and a pumpkin guessing game.
places.trip: U8 to Karl-Bonhoeffer-Nervenklinik, S25 to Hennigsdorf, RE6 to Kremmen, then bus 800 or a 10 minute walk. About 70 minutes. Outside the ABC zone.
weeks: Kürbisfest in the Scheunenviertel, Sat and Sun 10:00 to 18:00.
Late in the season. Call before you go.

places.name: Gutshof Fredersdorf
places.hours: Saturday 24 October from 15:00, with a bonfire in the evening.
places.what: A village pumpkin festival run by the local Heimatverein on the old manor yard opposite the church: bouncy castle, carousel, performances and food, then a fire after dark.
places.trip: S5 to Fredersdorf, then bus 949 to Fredersdorf (MOL), Kirche, or a 20 minute walk. About 50 to 60 minutes. Inside ABC.
